_rule: One source for the blind studies; BLIND_STUDIES.md is generated from it (CANON/blind_studies.py).
_protocol: **Protocol, fixed before any study is read.** (1) Studies are chosen from the GEO record's metadata only: platform, raw IDATs, a linked publication, and the design named in its title; no abstract or result is read. (2) Each study's question and the readings that answer it are written here before reading. (3) `CANON/blind_prep.py` takes only the array accession numbers from GEO (no titles, no labels) into a list whose SHA-256 is recorded; the specimen given to the chain is the tissue named by the design, or `unknown`, so the IAM-Deconvolver says what each array is made of. (4) Every array is read by the one command, run_sample.py, through the series workflow on GitHub, and the readings are committed. (5) Only then are the labels fetched from GEO and the publication opened; its headline finding is entered beside ours. (6) Verdict, fixed now: agree when our reading separates the study's groups in the published direction with an AUC of at least 0.7; disagree when it separates them the other way; not comparable when the publication's finding is not about a difference our readings measure. Exploration, not commissioning: every reading is flagged as the chain flags it. Known limit: the person running the chain may have prior knowledge of well-known studies; the protection is that the question, the scoring rule and the readings are committed before any finding is opened.
